role: Chest loot probe: draws every structure's WeightedRandomChestContent table (with the enchanted-book entry where the structure appends it) many times with the structure's own call expression into a 27-slot InventoryBasic, each draw from its own seeded Random; also writes the loot table header.
notes: Output DIR/manifest.json and DIR/draws.jsonl. Runs on the OTHER-role thread while the server is parked.
